title: Prestige Hospitality Ventures IPO
summary: Prestige Hospitality Ventures IPO is a book-built issue of about ₹2,700 crore, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Prestige Hospitality Ventures IPO has a total issue size of ₹2700 Crores Approx and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: JM Financial Ltd, CLSA India Pvt.Ltd., JP Morgan India Pvt.Ltd., Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd.

Prestige Hospitality Ventures financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Prestige Hotel Ventures is a luxury, upper upscale, and upper midscale hotel asset owner and developer company with business and leisure traveler segments in India. It is promoted by the Prestige Group and is backed by Prestige Estates Projects Limited (PEPL), a 38-year-old experienced real estate developer with a market capitalization of ₹729.66 billion as on December 31, 2024. · · PEPL has a presence in residential, commercial, hospitality, and retail segments. PEPL's portfolio consists of Operating, Ongoing, and Upcoming Hospitality Assets. The portfolio as of December 31, 2024, consists of: · Seven Operating Assets with 1,445 keys (including one undergoing renovation with 190 keys) · Three Ongoing Assets with 951 anticipated keys · Nine Upcoming Assets with 1,558 anticipated keys. · · The hotels owned by the company are situated in key Indian cities such as Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Goa, Hyderabad, and Chennai. · As of December 2024, the business had 1,638 permanent staff.
Prestige Estates Projects Limited are the company's promoters of Prestige Hospitality Ventures.

sections.h: Prestige Hospitality Ventures IPO Issue Objectives

ul: Repayment/ prepayment, in full or in part, of certain outstanding borrowings and accrued interest thereon availed by the Company
Material Subsidiaries, namely, Sai Chakra Hotels Private Limited and Northland Holding Company Private Limited, through investment in such subsidiaries
Pursuing inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions and other strategic initiatives and general corporate purposes
